fusions.name: Toss on the Horns
fusions.desc: Drives a low upward arc through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and tossing it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Drover's Goad
fusions.desc: A prodding reach that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Round Up
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Heels Dug In
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
